intro: In Stormwind, Arcane Feedback prepares priests to face hostile spellcasters. High Priestess Laurena teaches the rite in the Cathedral of Light, where faith is shaped into a defense against arcane power.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We were forced to learn some magics to protect us from what is commonly called our greatest enemy: the arcane.
I would teach you a spell to help you defend yourself and your companions from those who would wield such power.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
